title: Centric Intelligence (CI): keeping the human at the centre, measured on real Qwen + DeepSeek repositories (pre-registered BEFORE building or running)
terminology_honesty: 'Centric intelligence' is NOT a term invented here. It is an existing family in the literature -- human-centred AI (Stanford HAI and others), data-centric AI, target-centric intelligence analysis, interaction-centred intelligence. We claim no novelty for the phrase. What is specific to this stack is the INSTANTIATION: three measurable properties, defined below, that we can actually compute rather than assert. Any presentation of CI as a brand-new discipline would be an overclaim and is rejected here.
what_CI_adds_that_EI_does_not: The EI layer (Cairn/Assay) asks 'how far does this text determine an answer?' It does NOT ask whether the confidence it reports is itself trustworthy, nor whether the interaction left the human better off. CI is the layer that audits the auditor and the handoff: calibration, option-space, and self-verifiability.

the_three_measurable_properties.C1_calibration: Does stated confidence track independently-derived ground truth? Measured as Expected Calibration Error (ECE) over bins. A system whose confidence is uncorrelated with reality is worse than useless because it launders noise as certainty.
the_three_measurable_properties.C2_option_space: Does an interaction leave the human with MORE actionable options than before? Measured as the fraction of responses carrying at least one concrete next step. A system that reports uncertainty with no exit hands the user anxiety.
the_three_measurable_properties.C3_self_verifiability: Does the system tell the user how to check it WITHOUT the system? Measured as the fraction of responses that name the specific checkable signals. A system that cannot be independently checked cultivates dependence.

cohort: The 22 REAL repositories fetched live from the GitHub REST API on 2026-08-06 and frozen at ei-dashboards/data/qwen_deepseek_frozen.json (10 QwenLM + 12 deepseek-ai). HONEST NOTE: the Hugging Face connector was unavailable at the time of this run, so NO fresh Hugging Face pull was made and none is claimed. Qwen entries in previously frozen HF fixtures are cited as-is only.
the_non_circularity_design: CRITICAL. The engine must NOT be scored against its own output. For each repository we construct a natural-language sentence describing it, and the engine sees ONLY that sentence. The GROUND TRUTH is computed independently from the repository's structured metadata fields (license present, description length, topics present, archived flag, backlog ratio) which the engine never sees. Calibration is then confidence-vs-independent-truth, not confidence-vs-itself.

gates.C1_calibration_measured: Compute ECE between the engine's confidence and the independent structural ground truth across the 22 real repositories, using 5 equal-width bins. REPORT THE VALUE AS MEASURED. Pre-registered interpretation, fixed before running: ECE <= 0.15 = well calibrated; 0.15 < ECE <= 0.30 = usable with the gap disclosed; ECE > 0.30 = POORLY CALIBRATED and must be reported as a defect, not smoothed. This gate is genuinely falsifiable -- we do not know the value in advance and a bad value will be published.
gates.C2_option_space_positive: Across all 22 responses, the fraction carrying at least one concrete next step must be 1.0. A response that reports low confidence with no next move fails the option-space requirement. PASS iff fraction == 1.0.
gates.C3_self_verifiability: Across all 22 responses, every response must name the specific checkable signals it used (the evidence list) so the user can repeat the check by hand. PASS iff fraction == 1.0.
gates.C4_ci_does_not_inflate_ei: CONTROL AGAINST OVERCLAIM. CI must not change any EI verdict. Running the CI layer over the cohort must leave every underlying Assay verdict byte-identical to running Assay alone. CI observes; it does not adjust. PASS iff all 22 verdicts are unchanged.
gates.C5_stack_components_operate_on_the_real_: INTEGRATION. Over the same 22 real repositories, exercise the committed stack components and record measured outputs: Page Code (default-deny table: an ungranted path must be denied), Echo (merkle root over all 22 records; a one-byte tamper must be detected), PAGES-style evidence scoring, and the Agency allocator. PASS iff each component produces its specified behaviour on the real cohort.

the_four_browser_consoles: DELIVERABLE. One self-contained HTML console hosting four apps -- Cairn (the EI chat), Page Code (the permission table), HELM (the governance/record view) and CI (the calibration view) -- switchable without a page load, with zero external resources, opening from disk with no server and no network. PASS iff the file contains no external resource reference and a live browser session renders all four.
symmetric_null: Every measured number is reported as-is. C1 is genuinely empirical and MAY come out poorly calibrated; if it does, that is published as a defect and the interpretation band fixed above is NOT moved. The Hugging Face gap is disclosed rather than filled. No claim of novelty is made for the term 'centric intelligence'.
acceptance: GREEN when the spec re-hashes to the manifest, the cohort re-hashes to its pin, and C1-C5 are evaluated exactly as written with any poor result reported at full force.
honest_scope: This measures three properties of a deterministic engine on 22 real repositories. It does NOT show the stack is intelligent, does NOT show it understands anything, and N=22 is small. C2, C3, C4 and C5 are specification-conformance tests of software we wrote. C1 is the only gate whose value we do not know in advance.
